en.lkBanner: Locked for editing — locked by {name} at {time}

en.lkRefused: The document is locked for editing
en.shHint: Writes an editable HTML file into the HTML folder; send it to your coworker, who opens it and carries on.
en.explain.lkToggle: Locks the document against edits, or unlocks it after a warning; no password.
en.explain.shShare: Saves an HTML copy to share with a colleague, with its provenance log and lock state.
en.shTitle: Share the document with a coworker
en.shDoneLead: The share copy is saved in the HTML folder.

en.shOpened: The folder is open with the file selected
